pr_title: fs: Fix null pointer exception caused by async fs_unmount
pr_body:
If fs_unmount is invoked while fs i/o is ongoing then it will cause a NULL pointer exception due to the unchecked and unprotected dereference of the fs pointer.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73501

review_comments: I understand that this fixes problem with NULL pointer exception but unfortunately now systems continue write to system that is no longer valid.
In my testing the i/o errors out and returns an error code, which is a huge improvement over the NULL pointer exception.
Remove the "Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73501" from commit and description as this does not fix the problem, it only makes it manifest in a less violent way.
But it does fix "the problem", which is NULL pointer dereference caused by a user removing a usb drive during file i/o.
